title: A PHP source backup is served (/index.php.bak)
summary: A backup of a PHP file is downloadable as source rather than run, which reveals the application code.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("<?php") and body_differs(control) and not body_contains("<html")

remediate: Remove the backup from the web root and block .bak at the web server.
